name: Paulina Parks
source:
The self-appointed party queen of Starswirl. Polly is head cheerleader and it shows. She'll never miss an opportunity to spread some laughter and cheer to her classmates (whether they like it or not). Polly tends to put on a goofy face most of the time, but she can be serious when she needs to be.

[From [url=http://www.zap-apple.com/p/characters.html]the Starswirl Academy characters page[/url]]
